title: Effectiveness of Single Step Culture Media and Sequential Culture Media on Blastulation Rate
brief_summary: To compare the effectiveness of single step culture media and continuous uninterrupted culture media on blastulation rate
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Number of previous failure IVF cycles ≤2
* Using Gonadotropin-releasing hormone (GnRH) - Antagonist protocol for IVF
* Using GnRH for oocyte triggering.
* Read and sign consent form to participate in the study and have not been recruited for any other researches.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Oocyte donation cycles
* Abnormal uterine.
